messages.subject: Calverton v Ferncliffe - Defence served
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Please find our client's Defence served herewith. You will see liability is denied and our client relies on the inspection clause and the limitation provision at clause 11. We remain willing to discuss directions and, in due course, ADR.

Kind regards
Deepa Kovac
Birchall Stone LLP

messages.subject: Defence in - next steps to the CMC
messages.plaintextBody:
Patricia,

Ferncliffe's Defence is in, as expected: denial, deemed-acceptance under the inspection clause, and reliance on the clause 11 cap. Nothing we hadn't anticipated. Next is the costs and case management conference; I'll prepare a draft directions order, a list of issues and our costs budget, and arrange the joint inspection of the retained material. I'll also formally instruct Dr Iqbal.

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0148

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
